item.title: Solar micro grids going up in North Carolina to help storm prep
item.description: Solar microgrids are helping Western North Carolina to prepare for disasters like hurricane Helene, which devastated the region two years ago.

item.title: The federal law aimed at protecting college students from sexual abuse
item.description: The lawsuit by a former Cornell University student, alleging she was raped in 2024 by seven male students, has renewed long-standing concerns about how colleges deal with sexual assault.

item.title: The race to protect Santa Rosa Island's rare, damaged Torrey pines
item.description: In May, a fire damaged 80% of the trees one of the only two naturally-occurring groves of Torrey Pines in the world. The National Park Service is trying to help them recover.

item.description: President Trump met with AI CEOs at the White House on Tuesday and promoted a new government AI tool even as concerns about the technology's risks grow.

item.title: Anger mounts over Cornell's response to student's sexual assault allegations
item.description: Prosecutors have reopened an investigation into the alleged rape of a former Cornell University student in 2024. Now the governor of New York is calling for an independent investigation into Cornell.

item.title: Historic science museum in Philadelphia to close
item.description: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences is set to close down thanks to financial pressures. The 198-year-old museum houses important scientific specimens and a beloved dinosaur exhibit.
